bottleneck.summary: The SG216 comparator has all ten lambda gains +.0056…+.0372 and separate source Tc+.107 K, which is a modest coherent source response, not a calibrated significant physical gain. Different SG225 Mo2TcW and Mo3Tc neighbors outperform it; all preserved. No high-W claim or source-wide Ta/W ranking.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source coarse force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure 0.003 GPa; fine force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure 0.191 GPa. Actual full stress, Γ interval, finite path and q observations are retained in the complete review; no whole-BZ/global-stability claim.

proposed_contribution.intervention: Mo-to-W mapped role change within the SG216 Mo2TcW branch. coupled chemistry/site-role/volume/mass construction, not isolated geometry or inferred W/n
proposed_contribution.next_action: Compare retained mode/orbital weights and source Coulomb sensitivity within the exact SG216 pair, without substituting the better SG225 control. Favorable: small response retains sign under physically justified uncertainty; adverse: sign reverses; ambiguous: numerical/physical uncertainty exceeds gain.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
